messages:
Maya T.: Quick concept: a 'role ribbon' that sits above the matrix and lets you apply a role to selected rows. Think: select multiple people, open ribbon, choose 'Set role (no email)' or 'Invite & add (emails user)'. Keeps invites explicit and avoids modal overload. Proto: https://www.figma.com/file/role-ribbon/new-proto :sparkles:

Aran K.: I like centralizing bulk actions. A few accessibility/keyboard items: the ribbon must be reachable by keyboard (Shift+Tab from table footer), have clear focus order, and each action should be a real button with aria-pressed when active. Also, keyboard users need a clear way to select rows (space toggles).

Noor H.: Copy nit: prefer 'Set role' for existing members and 'Invite & add' for external invites. Make the distinction obvious in the ribbon with a small secondary line: 'Set role: no email sent' and 'Invite & add: will email and may affect billing'.

Samira R.: Accessibility checklist: ribbon controls need >=4.5:1 contrast; use aria-live polite for success toasts; when the ribbon is open trap focus inside it until an action completes or the user presses Esc. If role changes are blocked by SSO, disable the ribbon action and show an inline message: 'Some selected users are SSO-managed'. That message should be referenced by aria-describedby.

Maya T.: Audit requirement: when the ribbon applies changes emit structured events with method 'role_ribbon_bulk' and include the list of targets (hashed ids ok). Devs: sample payload: {event: 'role.bulk_change', actor: 'maya.t@redwood.com', targets: ['jordan@x.com'], from: 'Guest', to: 'Power', method: 'role_ribbon_bulk', ts: '2025-11-03T15:00:00Z'}. We'll deep-link the ribbon action to the audit rail.

Aran K.: UX edge: if selection contains mixed SSO and non-SSO users, ribbon should grey out the SSO-affecting option and show a tooltip 'SSO enforced for some selected users' on hover and focus. For keyboard users, make the tooltip reachable and include the reason in the aria-describedby for the disabled control.

Noor H.: Billing: if any change increases billed seats, show a billing preview in the ribbon: '+2 seats (billed)'. Add a short 12s grace period after applying with an accessible undo toast: 'Changed 3 users to Power  Undo'. Make undo focusable and visible.

Samira R.: Contrast and focus details: undo button must have a strong focus ring; test in high-contrast modes. Use role=status for the toast and aria-live=polite so screen readers announce but don't steal focus.

DesignBot: Example audit JSON for devs (insert into dev tools):

```
{"event":"role.bulk_change","actor":"maya.t@redwood.com","targets":["jordan@x.com","alex@x.com"],"from":"Guest","to":"Power","method":"role_ribbon_bulk","ts":"2025-11-03T15:00:00Z"}
```

Ribbon should link to the audit rail filtered by that ts.

Maya T.: Implementation checklist for engineering:
- role ribbon component with keyboard entry point, focus trap, and clear affordances
- ARIA: buttons with aria-pressed, aria-describedby for SSO/billing messages, role=status for toast
- copy: 'Set role (no email)' and 'Invite & add (emails user)' with short helper lines
- billing: preview chip + 12s undo grace for seat changes
- audit: emit role.bulk_change events with method 'role_ribbon_bulk' and deep-link support
- visuals: meet 4.5:1 contrast, visible focus outlines, tooltips on focus

Maya T.: Tagging follow-ups: @Aran K. please write keyboard map and focus flows; @Samira R. please run a11y pass on the Figma once I update it; @Noor H. can you draft the ribbon microcopy variants. I'll upload the prototype and schedule a short review on Tuesday. :rocket:
